start_frame: From the water side: the sister upright in the upper third with the book, Alice still on her stomach in the lower foreground, out-of-focus grass stems across the near edge.
end_frame: The same frame after she has rolled onto her back: her face and the picked daisy now large in the near foreground, the daisy dropping onto her pinafore, the sister unmoved in the upper third reading on.
constraint_honoured: 'One take, no move; single pick-and-drop gesture' — one locked 11.0 s frame; the composition changes only because she rolls through it.
movement_note: The longest waking take in the episode. A static frame lets the roll, the hush and the daisy all land in one shot without a reframe, and carries LN-ep01-002 (1.4 s) whole.
